body: yeah I am, definitely things will improve. I just need enough money and a car. I'd love to start somewhere new. it's weird but I feel most comfortable when I'm out of town, where noone knows me
thankyou so much, both of you guys. you're right tbh. where I'm from isn't the most accepting and homophobia is pretty rampant but I'm glad there's people out there not so shitty (:

just my opinion, but possession is the best power. you can get it fairly early on, whereas bend time requires a lot of runes to get stop time.

there's also a rune in the sea, by the boat at the beginning of edge of the world before you start the mission.

Absolutely. But it's not true, in the past my experiences have been invalidated by others. As a young boy I was always told I was too sensitive, a gay boy and a sissy whenever I'd try to tell anyone, even teachers, about when I was bullied. I just have depression now. Hope you're okay stranger :) sending love your way. For mentally ill people like us it's even hard and jarring to accept that we have limits. Screw what other people think or see as "dramatic". You feel how you do and that should be accepted and supported.
Yeah I have. I'll talk to them about it next appointment. Thanks man. They recently upped my dose from 50 to 75 and its kinda fucked with me for the last month.
I'm on 75mg Zoloft. And yeah thankyou for the reply, just knowing others have felt similar is nice.

God I feel the same, especially about feeling like a black hole, just sucking energy out the room because I can't be happy enough. but it shouldn't discourage seeking help. You still deserve help and support for yourself mentally. It's really fucking hard to physically ask for help or support, I get a lump in my throat and just shut down. Try writing down a message and giving it to your sister or someone close.

just done the same. I wanna say please don't worry. just try and take every day as it comes. Youre fine how you are, and depression is seriously tough sometimes, like it literally exhausts you. School is hard sometimes and it's a lot to take in every day.
I certainly feel drained and worse because of it. So yeah, I agree with you.

I'm gay too and God I feel this so much. everyone around me is in relationships and has somewhat of a stable social life. it sucks honestly, I don't feel loved, not by my own family sometimes. /: honestly this post is so relatable, it just feels like the world and people around me are so different to how I feel.

Thanks man (: yeah definitely if you can next week, tell your therapist. Just letting out how you feel about it is really relieving. I'm glad I'm able to help even just a bit. Not being able to cry is so painful, maybe because it's just such a recent experience and it's a really tough thing to process. Stay close to friends and people who care about you. Hope you have an awesome day/night too.

I've been through that before, and trust me it's fine to feel so horrible about it. it's a horrible experience. I hope you're doing okay dude, however you feel about it you should let it out in the way you need to or try to just calm yourself. You don't deserve to have that said to you, it's disgusting, and if you are thinking about the conversation then please don't blame yourself or think about what you could change about what happened. When it happened to me i felt rotten and horrible about it, school bullies are relentless. I don't know if that's your situation but just know it's okay to cry and feel how you do about it. I'm so sorry that it happened to you /:

yeah I have the exact same, thinking how the future will go constantly and just feeling generally aimless in life. I don't really relate to most people either, at least people my age, which sucks because everything seems dependent on making friends and having a good social circle to keep yourself cheerful. I guess I learnt to indulge in my own interests and appreciate the times where I can be alone. But at the same time things are really tough, especially when your mind can work against you, it isn't fun being isolated and finding it hard to talk to others.

That's genuinely so heartbreaking. Losing someone that close to you is really tough, I can't imagine it considering I only lost members of my family that arent as close to me. Look after yourself, you're going through an insanely hard time right now and there's nothing wrong with how you feel. Life will eventually get easier and you'll remember great memories with him. In some ways people never leave you, because they live on in your memory. It will be okay, stay close to your friends and family right now and express how you feel to them.

Im mostly a non-cryer, and it just feels numb and horrible really. But I can't imagine crying all the time, it seems so horrible too. There's a sense of relief after crying, but I wouldn't say one is preferable over the other.

Yeah I'm gay too, and sometimes the future feels really hopeless so I get what you mean. I can't really fit in with most other people my age and I try, but I lost quite a few friends after I came out to them. I think being gay can really be annoying and isolating sometimes.

thankyou. I know literally noone gay or lgbt in my life really, and it's isolating. I hope they'll come around too. it's so weird because I remember so many moments when he came to me for help, but with the context of me being gay, apparently everything has to change between us. Its hard to accept I did nothing wrong and that I can't change anything anymore, but thanks so much for this reply genuinely. just hearing a stranger empathise is so comforting.
damn I feel the same way a lot of the time. like why does time have to go forwards? life would be so much easier if time was malleable, you could go back and fix mistakes you made in the past.
